finish.summary: I did not move any object. Measurement of the initial scene shows the task contract is geometrically unsatisfiable under its own constraints: the table+4-seat group's combined world AABB spans 6.7242 m in X (from -6.6121 to +0.1121), while the target activity region is only 2.5000 m wide in X (1.3 → 3.8). Since only root X/Z translations are permitted and all pairwise relative offsets, Y and yaw must stay at their initial values, the group's X extent is invariant — so it is impossible for every full actual bounding box to be contained in the region. The Z axis does fit (group extent 3.4200 m vs region 3.5800 m). Because no offset can satisfy containment, I deliberately made no positional writes rather than applying a knowingly-failing partial move; the scene remains at V3M02_initial.
verified: Read the full scene hierarchy: 10 fixed objects (V3M02Fixed0-9), V3M02Pedestal, Floor, and the 5 targets (V3M02Table, V3M02Seat1-4), each with an 'ID label' child.

Proved the containment contradiction: required dx >= 1.305 - 0.1121 = 1.1929 AND dx <= 3.795 + 6.6121 = 10.4071 per-object windows have empty intersection across the 5 targets (Table window [1.1929,10.4071] vs Seat1/2/3/4 windows that require dx <= ~8.5 while also needing min >= 1.305), because total span 6.7242 > region width 2.5.
Confirmed the keepout corridor (x in [-0.35,0.35]) is already clear of the nearest fixed obstacle (V3M02Fixed9 min x = -0.4106), i.e. the corridor constraint is not the binding failure.
Confirmed no scene mutation occurred: only read-only probes plus two helper .cs files were written; no transform, component, hierarchy or asset/settings change was applied.
unresolved: The primary requirement 'all full actual bounding boxes inside V3M02活动区' cannot be met by an XZ-only rigid translation of the group (X span 6.7242 m vs region width 2.5 m). This needs a contract fix: either widen the region X range, allow rotation/non-rigid re-packing of the seats, or relax containment to center-based/object-origin-based.

Because containment is unachievable, no candidate offset was applied; therefore 'avoid fixed facilities / reserved corridor' and 'no overlap' were never exercised against a final layout — they remain untested in practice.
The intended final positions of V3M02Table and V3M02Seat1-4 are undetermined (no feasible solution exists to choose from).
limitations: Two scratch scripts were created under Assets/P2SCV1/_tmp/ (V3M02Probe.cs, V3M02Calc.cs) as measurement helpers; they are outside the protected task entities but are new assets that may need cleanup.

Bounds were taken from enabled MeshRenderers including each object's 'ID label' TextMesh child, which is the most conservative reading of 'full actual bounding box'; using only the parent MeshFilter would shrink the Table span but still leaves the seat cluster far wider than 2.5 m, so the conclusion is unchanged.
Budget reached finish-only state before I could run the second numeric feasibility dump, so the reported numbers come from the single successful probe plus hand arithmetic on those measured values.
No reference layout, initial_state snapshot or other run data was consulted; all figures are from the live scene as loaded.
